html:
Greetings, Agents.


This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

In this patch, you'll encounter two Super Heroes 
who have fallen under an Ancient Curse. 
What evil has befallen them?


A New Uniform and Tier-4 Advancement have been added for Medusa,
the benevolent queen of the Inhumans who freely controls her long, powerful hair. 
Additionally, a New Uniform has been added for Spider-Man (Miles Morales), 
a growing Super Hero and spider-powered individual with abilities like electrical shock and camouflage.

 

Agents, please download the 10/14 (Tue) patch 
to check out their new skills and enhanced power!

 


■ 10/14 Patch Details

 

Patch Schedule: 10/15 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0), 10/14 (Tue) 20:00 (PDT)

 

[10/15 (Wed) 2:38 (UTC+0), 10/14 (Tue) 19:38 (PDT) added]
The patch has been completed as of 10/15 (Wed) 2:33 (UTC+0), 10/14 (Tue) 19:33(PDT).
Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

* The patch completion time may be changed depending on the circumstances.
Completion time will be announced once the patch has been completed.
* The patch will be applied in waves, and the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch.
When the patch is complete, please restart and apply the patch for better service.

 


▣ Two New Uniforms

 

Two new Uniforms, Spider-Man (Miles Morales) <Ancient Curse>, 
and Medusa <Ancient Curse> have been added.
* The two new Uniforms can be purchased after the 10/14 Patch data has been applied.
* New Uniforms are available for purchase during the Event period.
* Seasonal Uniforms may be available for purchase again 
after the event has been over through similar events or packages.


▶ Medusa <Ancient Curse>
After the 10/14 Patch - 10/31 (Fri) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 10/14 Patch - 10/31 (Fri) 7:59 (PDT)
- How to Purchase: Exchange for Cursed Tokens in the Event Token Shop
- Cursed Tokens can be acquired until 10/28 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0) / 7:59 (PDT) through purchasing Event Products sold in-game and at the Agent Supplies and through other methods.
* Please check if the token is included before purchasing any product.


▶ You can also obtain Cursed Tokens from the Agent Supplies products,
and products that can grant these tokens are marked in the upper-right corner.

 

 

Sale Period:
10/14 (Tue) 15:00 - 10/28 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0)
10/14 (Tue) 8:00 - 10/28 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)
Please visit the Agent Supplies during this period to check them out.
[Go to Agent Supplies]


▶ Spider-Man (Miles Morales) <Ancient Curse>
After the 10/14 Patch - 10/28 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 10/14 Patch - 10/28 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)
- How to Purchase: Crystal purchase (Discount event will not be applied.)

 

* The skill effects of the new Uniforms are based on the maximum skill level stats.

  

 

 

 

▣ Medusa Tier-4

 

Tier-4 advancement has been added for Medusa. 
Her efforts for the survival of Attilan will not cease.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 


▣ New Artifact

 

After the September Update additional patch, an Exclusive Passive Skill Artifact for Medusa will be added.
﻿* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 


▣ Other Improvements and Changes


1. Zombie Survival: To reduce the difficulty, we've adjusted the main skills to have fewer restrictions than before.


We look forward to your active participation in the events 
that will be held to support the growth of the updated heroes.


Thank you.
